story: On 5 Oct, WNY Women's Foundation and Citizen Collab ran Collective Power for Change, a free voter education rally in Buffalo. It was livestreamed. Rebecca says the content is really clear, concise, and useful.

Her ask, in her words: Edit the recording to eliminate the dead space, and the times when table partners were talking or working. I'll put the edited version on our website, and we'll send it out to organizations to be dispersed widely to the public. So this is a website video and a video partner groups will share. Do not start yet. We have no source file. Strictly non-partisan: no party, no candidate, no issue.
